mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_reply (post_id, user_id, content, create_time) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.post_id AS postId, r.user_id AS userId, r.content, r.create_time AS createTime, u.username AS authorName, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl FROM t_reply r LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY r.create_time ASC, r.id ASC
